root_cause.text: The `um_tlb_sync` function in the User Mode Linux (UML) architecture modifies and traverses the page table without acquiring the `mm->page_table_lock`, causing a race condition during TLB synchronization.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `guard(spinlock_irqsave)(&mm->page_table_lock)` to `arch/um/kernel/tlb.c` within `um_tlb_sync`, and the CVE description explicitly states that page table traversal during TLB sync requires holding the page table lock due to missing full SMP support for threads within the same process.
